investigation_notes.Recent Similar Alert: SOC-11300 (closed as FP; client confirmed ChatGPT automated synchronization)
investigation_notes.Description: An automated client named ChatGPT using a Python aiohttp user agent downloaded 300 SharePoint files from SRV-PROD at 2026-01-05T10:33:46Z (local time ~12:33 in Tallinn). The activity matches a recent, similar alert that the client validated as an authorized ChatGPT-driven synchronization and the access pattern and user agent indicate scripted automated behavior rather than interactive user exfiltration. Because the downloads occurred during local business hours, match a previously confirmed false positive, and show clear automation indicators, the activity is assessed as low risk.
